name: Biomaterials & Tissue Engineering
summary: Covers materials placed in the body, how the body responds to them, and how scaffolds and biomaterials are designed to repair or replace tissue.

topics.name: History and classes of biomaterials: metals, ceramics, polymers and composites
Host response: inflammation, foreign-body reaction and fibrous encapsulation
Metallic implants: Ti alloys, CoCr, stainless steel; corrosion and wear debris
Bioceramics and bioactive glasses; bone bonding
Biomedical polymers and hydrogels; biodegradable polymers (PLA, PGA, PCL)
Orthopaedic and dental implants; joint replacement
Cardiovascular materials: stents, heart valves and blood compatibility
Tissue engineering scaffolds: porosity, degradation and cell seeding
Sterilisation, regulation (FDA/CE) and device failure case studies
